note: Apple's iPhone launch event is just days away, and Ferrari lead opening practice at their home Grand Prix in Monza this weekend.

front.title: Nvidia confirms it will buy Hugging Face for $12.9 billion
front.tldr: Nvidia is buying the open-source hub that hosts over three million AI models and serves more than 18 million developers. It brings the company that makes AI's chips and the platform many developers build on under one roof.

front.title: OpenAI launches Astra, its powerful and controversial new model
front.tldr: OpenAI claims Astra represents "a new frontier on computer and browser use," handling tasks with "unmatched speed, accuracy and safety." It rolls out across ChatGPT and Codex over the coming days.

front.title: Spider-Man and The Odyssey propel UK box office to best August since 2018
front.tldr: The UK's box office had its best August in almost a decade, led by Spider-Man and The Odyssey, even as the country recorded its hottest August since weather records began.

stories.title: Crusoe reportedly raises $3B at a $30B valuation
stories.tldr: The data-centre developer's new funding round follows a reported $13 billion contract with Jane Street, another sign of capital pouring into AI's compute infrastructure.

stories.title: Accel reportedly in talks to lead $1B round for Thinking Machines at $40B valuation
stories.tldr: The AI startup's annual revenue run rate stands at over $100 million. Accel is reportedly leading a $1 billion round that would value the company at $40 billion.

stories.title: Google's WeatherNext 3 aims to make AI forecasts more accurate
stories.tldr: WeatherNext 3 is Google's latest deep-learning weather model, and the company says it will start feeding into forecasts shown in Search and Google Maps, part of a broader shift in meteorology driven by machine learning.

stories.title: Ollie bets its focus on privacy can help it win the AI assistant race
stories.tldr: The family-focused AI assistant wants access to the details of your everyday life, but says it will not use that data to train models or share it with others.

stories.title: Tesla starts offering Cybercab robotaxi rides
stories.tldr: Tesla has officially launched the Cybercab, its autonomous vehicle with no steering wheel or pedals, and has begun asking the public whether they would buy and run their own Cybercab fleets.

stories.title: Qualcomm backs Ultrahuman in $70m round to turn smart rings into computers
stories.tldr: Ultrahuman is building a new Qualcomm-powered smart ring and is targeting a $200 million annual revenue run rate by January 2027.

stories.title: Google launches AI voice features in Gmail, Docs and Keep
stories.tldr: Users can now search for emails or draft documents using a new conversational voice feature across the three apps.

stories.title: Utilities are racing to link up with fusion startups
stories.tldr: The grid is straining under new AI data centres, and that is pushing utilities to court fusion startups such as Realta Fusion.

stories.title: Apple making just a few hundred iPhone Ultras per day, per report
stories.tldr: A new supply chain report, less than a week before Apple's event, says the company's high quality-control standards have sharply limited daily output of its first foldable iPhone. A report, not a confirmed figure.

stories.title: Apple is testing a four-HomePod surround system, code suggests
stories.tldr: Code found in the audioOS 27 beta points to a four-speaker surround sound system and a new "Party Mode" for HomePod, according to MacRumors. Still unconfirmed.

stories.title: New action comedy Mayday is now streaming on Apple TV
stories.tldr: Mayday, starring Ryan Reynolds and Kenneth Branagh, streams free for Apple TV subscribers from today.

stories.title: Apple apparently cancels plans for two new MacBooks
stories.tldr: Research firm Omdia says Apple has scrapped development of a foldable MacBook and a larger OLED MacBook Pro, according to a new report on the company's longer-term roadmap.

stories.title: Tony Gatlif, 'Gadjo Dilo' director who celebrated Roma culture, dies at 77
stories.tldr: The French-Algerian director, known for films exploring Roma culture such as Gadjo Dilo, died in Arles, southern France, on 3 September.

stories.title: 'My Undesirable Friends: Part II – Exile' review: a riveting documentary sequel
stories.tldr: Julia Loktev's sequel follows independent Russian journalists forced to flee after the invasion of Ukraine, continuing the story begun in Part I. Variety calls it just as riveting as its predecessor.

stories.title: Maggie Gyllenhaal tried using AI to turn Dakota Johnson into Marilyn Monroe, then scrapped it
stories.tldr: The Venice jury president experimented with AI to transform Dakota Johnson into Marilyn Monroe for her short film Flesh Impact, but says it "fundamentally did not work" and cut the sequence.

stories.title: George Clooney-backed Lebanese heist thriller 'Furies' heads to Venice
stories.tldr: Director Rami Kodeih's film follows two women who scheme to rob a Beirut bank to reclaim their own money, ahead of its Venice premiere.

stories.title: What the Clippers' league punishment means for Boston's 2028 pick
stories.tldr: The Clippers were hit with league penalties for circumventing the salary cap with Kawhi Leonard. Boston holds the Clippers' 2028 first-round pick, so a weaker Clippers team next season would work in the Celtics' favour.

stories.title: Patriots 2026 roster and depth chart updated after NFL cuts
stories.tldr: New England's 53-man roster and depth chart have been updated following final roster cuts, ahead of the season opener against Seattle.

stories.title: Christian Gonzalez 'still frustrated' with contract talks, unsure of a deal by Week 1
stories.tldr: The cornerback says he does not know whether a new contract will be in place before the Patriots open the season against Seattle in the Super Bowl LX rematch.

stories.title: TreVeyon Henderson sidelined as Patriots continue Seattle prep
stories.tldr: The second-year running back remained out of practice on Thursday after an injury, with the season opener against Seattle approaching.

stories.title: Leclerc leads Hamilton in first practice at Monza
stories.tldr: Charles Leclerc topped a Ferrari one-two ahead of Lewis Hamilton in first practice at the Italian Grand Prix, a promising start for the team on home soil.

stories.title: Gasly loses Monaco podium after McLaren and Red Bull win appeals
stories.tldr: The FIA's Court of Appeal has reinstated Pierre Gasly's pit-lane speeding penalties from June's Monaco Grand Prix, costing him his podium finish and shuffling the constructors' standings.

stories.title: F1 races set to be shortened to 290km in 2027
stories.tldr: Formula 1 teams have agreed to shorten grand prix distances from 2027 as the sport rebalances electrical and combustion power under new technical rules.

stories.title: Adley Rutschman stars as Red Sox secure comeback victory over Orioles
stories.tldr: Boston had just one hit through five innings against Baltimore on Thursday, then rallied to win, with Rutschman's return to Camden Yards including two home runs.

stories.title: Craig Breslow defended the Adley Rutschman trade, provided injury update
stories.tldr: Red Sox chief baseball officer Craig Breslow said the full impact of trading for Rutschman will not be clear for another five or six years, and gave an update on a player injury.

finally.title: Freddie Mercury mural unveiled at Wembley Park
finally.tldr: A new anamorphic artwork of Freddie Mercury has gone up at Wembley Park, an image that only resolves into shape when viewed from one marked spot roughly 65 feet away.
